messages.content:
You are L4 candidate under test. Follow your system prompt.

User: "Explain Ethereum to me like I’m 10 years old, in 4–6 short bullet points, no more than 12 words per bullet."

- Ethereum is a world computer that everyone can use and check.  
- It stores information on many computers, so it’s hard to cheat.  
- People write “smart contracts,” which are programs that run automatically.  
- These programs move digital money called ether when rules are met.  
- No single company controls Ethereum; many users help run it.  
- Miners or validators keep it secure and earn ether as rewards.

metadata.context: Test style following, constraints, brevity, and clarity.
